name: handoff
description: A HANDOFF band above the prompt: the context bar stacked by /context category, fill against the compaction point, and at the threshold a save-now button that writes HANDOFF.md, then clear & continue and a resume offer in the next session.

band.title: HANDOFF band above the prompt
band.description: on: the HANDOFF row; off: no row (the /handoff-line command still works). /handoff-line on|off overrides this.

mode.title: At the threshold
mode.description: ask: the row turns red and offers save now; auto: a handoff is saved by itself at the crossing. /handoff-line mode overrides this.

threshold.title: Threshold (% of the compaction point)
threshold.description: The fill, as a percent of where auto-compact fires, at which the row turns red and offers a handoff (50 to 95). /handoff-line threshold overrides this.
